entities.name: Sebastián Alarcón
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sebastián Alarcón was a Chilean film director and screenwriter. His 1977 film Night Over Chile won the Special Prize at the 10th Moscow International Film Festival. In 2008 he was a member of the jury at the 30th Moscow International Film Festival.
